g.text: G · Two deep: branch and gather
One way in, up a feeder that branches into an aisle a
row; the aisles gather into one way out. Bays line the aisles only.
H · Two deep on the corner
Each aisle its own way in off the side street, no
feeder; they gather into one way out.
Three aisles off one feeder. The bigger the lot, the less
of it the turns at the ends take.
the way cars drive, one way
a turn tighter than a car turns (0.45)
A tile is 60 px (12 m). A car 0.29 × 0.15, an aisle 0.22,
bays at 60° and 0.2 across. Bays are placed by test:
wholly on the lot, clear of every aisle and of each other.
